lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Safely Operating Near Oversize & Overweight Vehicles
prompt: What is the purpose of emergency runaway truck ramps located along steep mountain downgrades?

options.text: Serve as designated overnight recreational camping sites for commercial drivers
Allow highway patrol officers to perform roadside vehicle emissions inspections
Provide escape lane with deep gravel bed to decelerate trucks that lost brake control
Provide scenic overlook viewpoints for tourists photographing mountain vistas
